claim_boundary: The lemma propagates the three stated fixed graph-template identities only. It does not classify other STAR-kernel circuits, prove a parameterized straightening family, prove the full STAR quarantine, decide MAX11, establish ansatz completeness, or imply an unrestricted neural-network lower bound.

deletion_lemma.normalization: Raw full S_n orbit symmetrization of a fixed signed pair-max graph template, including the frozen degree-five nonloop padding convention and inactive-label multiplicity.
deletion_lemma.statement: If an integer linear combination of finitely many graph-template orbit atoms, each supported on at most K labelled vertices, is exactly zero at ambient dimension K, then the same template identity is exactly zero for every ambient dimension n >= K.
